name: Percent
description: Percent: hundredths, so 12 % means 12 out of 100 and can also be written as 0.12 or 12/100.

name: Power and square root
description:
Power: a number multiplied by itself a given number of times, so 1.05^3 means 1.05 · 1.05 · 1.05.
Square root: the positive number that gives the original number when multiplied by itself, so √49 = 7.

name: Calculate a percentage of an amount
description: calculate a given percentage of an amount, by hand for simple percentages and with a calculator for the rest.

name: Calculate what percentage one amount is of another
description: calculate how many percent one amount is of another, and state the answer as a percentage.

name: Percentage change
description: Percentage change: the size of a change compared with the original value, given in percent.

name: Calculate a percentage change
description: calculate by how many percent a value has increased or decreased, always comparing with the original value.

name: Percentage point
description: Percentage point: the unit for the difference between two percentages, so going from 20 % to 25 % is a rise of 5 percentage points.

name: Explain the difference between percentage points and percent
description: explain the difference between a change in percentage points and a percentage change, and calculate both for the same pair of percentages.

name: Growth factor
description: Growth factor: the number the original value is multiplied by to give the new value; 1 + p/100 for an increase of p %, and 1 − p/100 for a decrease of p %.

name: Convert between percentage change and growth factor
description: find the growth factor from a percentage increase or decrease, and read the percentage change back off a given growth factor.

name: Calculate a new value with a growth factor
description: calculate the new value after a percentage change by multiplying the original value by the growth factor.

name: Find the original value before a percentage change
description: find the value before a percentage change by dividing the new value by the growth factor, and explain why subtracting the percentage from the new value gives the wrong answer.

name: Calculate the result of repeated percentage changes
description: calculate the result of several percentage changes in a row by multiplying the growth factors, write the same change repeated n times as a power, and state the total change in percent.

name: Model percentage growth with a digital tool
description: set up a spreadsheet or GeoGebra model of a practical situation with repeated percentage growth or decline, and use it to answer questions such as when a value passes a given limit.

name: Variable and expression
description:
Variable: a letter that stands for a number that is unknown or can vary.
Expression: numbers, variables and operations put together without an equals sign, such as 3x + 20.

name: Equation
description: Equation: a statement that two expressions are equal; a solution is a value of the variable that makes the statement true.

name: Solve a linear equation
description: solve a linear equation by doing the same thing on both sides, including equations with brackets and fractions.

name: Argue for the steps in solving an equation
description: check a solution by putting it back into the equation, and explain why each step keeps the two sides equal.

name: Rearrange a formula
description: rearrange a formula to find a chosen quantity, using the same rules as when solving an equation.

name: Set up an equation from a practical situation
description: set up an equation from a situation described in words, solve it, and answer the question in a sentence.

name: Coordinate system
description: Coordinate system: two number lines at right angles to each other, where every point is given by a pair of numbers (x, y).

name: Straight line
description: Straight line: the graph of y = ax + b, where a is the slope (how much y changes when x increases by 1) and b is where the line crosses the y-axis.

name: System of equations
description: System of equations: two equations with two unknowns; the solution is the pair of values that makes both equations true at the same time.

name: Solve a system of equations by calculation
description: solve a system of two linear equations with two unknowns by substitution or by elimination.

name: Solve a system of equations graphically
description: solve a system of two linear equations by drawing both lines, by hand or in GeoGebra, and reading off the point where they cross.

name: Set up a system of equations from a practical situation
description: set up a system of two equations from a situation described in words, such as comparing two price plans, solve it, and interpret the solution in the situation.

name: Inequality
description: Inequality: a statement using <, >, ≤ or ≥; its solution is usually a whole range of values rather than a single number.

name: Solve a linear inequality
description: solve a linear inequality, turn the inequality sign when multiplying or dividing by a negative number, and show the solution on a number line.

name: Compare strategies for solving equations
description: solve the same problem in more than one way — by calculation, graphically, or by trial in a spreadsheet — and argue for which method suits the problem best.

name: Price index
description: Price index: a number showing the price level in a given year compared with a base year set to 100; in Norway the consumer price index (KPI) is used.

name: Convert prices between years with the price index
description: convert a price or wage from one year to another using the price index, and calculate how many percent prices have changed between two years.

name: Krone value
description: Krone value: how much one krone buys in a given year compared with the base year, found as 100 divided by the price index.

name: Nominal and real wage
description:
Nominal wage: the wage in kroner, as it is paid out.
Real wage: the wage adjusted for price changes, which shows what it can actually buy measured in base-year kroner.

name: Calculate real wage
description: calculate the real wage from the nominal wage and the price index or krone value, and decide whether purchasing power has risen or fallen between two years.

name: Gross and net income
description:
Gross income: income before tax is deducted.
Net income: what is left after tax and other deductions, which is what is actually paid out.

name: Calculate net income
description: calculate net income from gross income using a given tax percentage or a tax deduction table.

name: Explain how wages, prices and tax are connected
description: explain how price index, krone value, nominal wage, real wage, gross income and net income depend on each other, for example why a pay rise can still leave someone worse off.

name: Budget and accounts
description:
Budget: a plan for expected income and expenses over a period.
Accounts: a record of the income and expenses that actually occurred.

name: Set up a budget in a spreadsheet
description: set up a monthly budget in a spreadsheet based on net income, compare it with the actual accounts, and suggest changes where it does not balance.

name: Loan terms
description:
Principal: the amount borrowed.
Interest: the price of borrowing, given as a percentage per year of what is still owed.
Instalment: the part of each payment that pays back the principal.
Term amount: the full payment each term, that is instalment plus interest and fees.

name: Serial loan and annuity loan
description:
Serial loan: a loan where the instalment is the same every term, so the term amount falls over time.
Annuity loan: a loan where the term amount is the same every term, so the instalment grows as the interest falls.

name: Effective interest rate
description: Effective interest rate: the total yearly cost of a loan including fees and interest on interest, given as a percentage; it is the figure to compare loans by.

name: Make a repayment plan for a serial loan
description: set up a repayment plan for a serial loan, by hand for the first few terms and in a spreadsheet for the whole loan, and find the total interest paid.

name: Find the cost of an annuity loan with a digital tool
description: use a spreadsheet or a loan calculator to find the term amount and the total cost of an annuity loan, and describe how the split between interest and instalment changes over time.

name: Compare loan offers
description: compare two loan offers by total cost and effective interest rate, and explain which is cheaper and why.

name: Calculate how a credit card debt grows
description: calculate how an unpaid credit card or consumer loan debt grows with monthly interest, and explain what happens when only the minimum amount is paid.

name: Assess choices in personal finance
description: assess a choice in personal finance, such as buying on credit, taking out a loan or saving first, by calculating the cost of each option and arguing for its consequences.

name: Frequency and relative frequency
description:
Frequency: how many times a value occurs in a dataset.
Relative frequency: the frequency as a share of all the observations, often given in percent.

name: Cumulative frequency
description: Cumulative frequency: the frequency of a value added to the frequencies of all smaller values, so it tells how many observations are at or below that value.

name: Make a frequency table
description: sort raw data into a frequency table with columns for frequency, relative frequency and cumulative frequency.

name: Present data in a suitable diagram
description: present data in a bar chart, pie chart, line chart or histogram, and justify which diagram suits the data and the message.

name: Mean, median and mode
description:
Mean: the sum of all the observations divided by the number of observations.
Median: the middle value when the observations are sorted by size.
Mode: the value that occurs most often.

name: Calculate mean, median and mode from a list
description: calculate mean, median and mode from a list of observations, including the median of an even number of observations.

name: Calculate mean, median and mode from a frequency table
description: calculate mean, median and mode from a frequency table, using the cumulative frequency to find the median.

name: Grouped data
description:
Grouped data: observations sorted into intervals, called classes, instead of being listed as single values.
Class midpoint: the value in the middle of a class, used to stand in for every observation in that class.

name: Estimate the mean of grouped data
description: estimate the mean of grouped data using class midpoints, and explain why the answer is only an estimate.

name: Range and interquartile range
description:
Range: the difference between the largest and the smallest observation.
Quartiles: the values that split the sorted observations into four equally large parts; the median is the second quartile.
Interquartile range: the difference between the upper and the lower quartile, covering the middle half of the data.

name: Calculate range and interquartile range
description: calculate the range, the quartiles and the interquartile range of a dataset.

name: Standard deviation
description: Standard deviation: a measure of how far the observations typically lie from the mean; a larger value means the data are more spread out.

name: Find the standard deviation with a digital tool
description: find the standard deviation of a dataset with a spreadsheet or GeoGebra, and interpret what the value says about the data.

name: Outlier
description: Outlier: an observation that lies far away from the rest of the data.

name: Choose suitable central and spread measures
description: choose which central measure and which spread measure best describe a dataset, and justify the choice, for example using the median and interquartile range when there are outliers.

name: Judge statistics presented in the media
description: judge whether a diagram or a figure in the media gives a fair picture, looking for cut axes, misleading use of percent and percentage points, and unsuitable central measures.

name: Analyse and present a real dataset
description: analyse a dataset from the local community or the media with a digital tool, and present the findings with suitable diagrams and measures, including what the data cannot tell us.

name: Convert between units
description: convert between units of length, area and volume, including litres, and explain why 1 m² is 10 000 cm².

name: Ratio
description: Ratio: a comparison of two quantities by division, written a : b or a/b.

name: Scale
description: Scale: the ratio between a length on a map or drawing and the same length in reality, such as 1 : 50 000.

name: Calculate with scale
description: convert between lengths on a map or drawing and real lengths, and find the scale when one length is known both on the drawing and in reality.

name: Similar figures
description: Similar figures: figures with the same shape but possibly different size; corresponding angles are equal and corresponding sides have the same ratio.

name: Decide whether two triangles are similar
description: decide whether two triangles are similar by comparing angles or side ratios, and point out which sides correspond.

name: Calculate lengths in similar figures
description: calculate unknown side lengths in similar figures by setting up the ratio between corresponding sides as an equation.

name: Use similarity to measure in practice
description: use similar triangles to find a length that cannot be measured directly, such as the height of a tree from the length of its shadow.

name: Perimeter and area
description:
Perimeter: the length all the way round a figure.
Area: the size of the surface a figure covers, measured in square units.

name: Calculate perimeter and area
description: calculate the perimeter and area of rectangles, triangles, parallelograms, trapezoids, circles and figures made up of these.

name: Right-angled triangle
description:
Right-angled triangle: a triangle where one angle is 90°.
Hypotenuse: the longest side, opposite the right angle.
Leg: each of the two sides that form the right angle.

name: Use Pythagoras' theorem
description: calculate a missing side in a right-angled triangle with Pythagoras' theorem, and check whether a triangle is right-angled.

name: Volume and surface area
description:
Volume: how much space a solid takes up, measured in cubic units.
Surface area: the total area of all the faces of a solid.

name: Calculate volume and surface area
description: calculate the volume and surface area of prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones and spheres, and convert volumes to litres.

name: Calculate how area and volume change with scale
description: calculate how area changes by the square and volume by the cube of the scale factor when a figure is enlarged or reduced, and explain why.

name: Plan a practical job with geometry
description: plan a practical job, such as laying a floor or painting a room from a drawing, by calculating the amount of material needed and what it will cost.
